name: wakfu-coach
description: Asistente RAG y coach personalizado para Wakfu (cuenta free-to-play, foco Ninivix). Hono + Drizzle/SQLite + Astro + Docker.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run check -w server && npm run check -w frontend
